name: f6-temporal-dynamics-person-evolution-graph
description: Renders this folder's own 'before-during-after-follow-up' figure for one study, as a standalone HTML page: a line connecting one subject's own real CDIx(t) across real sessions, segments tinted by the sign of their own real DELTA_CDI (never implying better/worse), with hover detail per point and per segment. Reads the already-written GDX_HNF_TRAJECTORY_RUN/POINT/STEP rows (F6_TEMPORAL_DYNAMICS_PERSON_EVOLUTION's own output) -- never recomputes CDIx or re-groups sessions itself.
